title: Faces of Fairness: Examining Bias in Facial Expression Recognition Datasets and Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracted age groups using DeepFace to evaluate dataset representation imbalances via statistical and information-theoretic metrics (e.g., Wasserstein Distance, Sparsity Index), and assessed model predictions using Equalized Odds, Equal Opportunity, Demographic Parity, and Treatment Equality across four distinct age brackets.

Extracted gender attributes using DeepFace to measure dataset distribution skews with statistical metrics (e.g., Jensen-Shannon Divergence, Group Normalized Mutual Information), and evaluated model fairness using four parity and error-distribution metrics comparing 'Man' and 'Woman' categories.

Extracted six racial categories (White, Black, Asian, Indian, Latinx, Middle Eastern) using DeepFace to quantify dataset demographic imbalances, and measured model predictive fairness across these groups using Equalized Odds, Equal Opportunity, Demographic Parity, and Treatment Equality.
